title: Refund Desk Note on Paying Money Back on a Closed Commission
content:
# Refund Desk Note on Paying Money Back on a Closed Commission

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request, money already paid on it is returned to the customer against the earlier payment it answers. The refund is worked out only after the studio's request record carries the customer's own confirmation of the closure and of the sum the studio keeps.

Read the other way: while the studio's request record does not yet carry that confirmation of the closure, standing as confirmed by the customer and bearing the sum the studio keeps, the refund is not yet worked out.

## What the payment back does

One call adds a single refund entry to the commission against the earlier payment being returned, reducing what the customer owes on that commission by the amount given and putting that money back to the customer on the studio's own refund run. The quoted total, the design revisions and the production stage stay exactly as they are. The customer sees the refund on their commission file against the payment it answers.

## How the refund is paid

The refund is paid on the studio's own tool `issue_commission_refund_b90496cb`. The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `custom_order_id` | The commission record the refund is booked against | An identifier, as read from the design studio's commission lookup for this customer |
| `commission_reference` | The reference the customer is given for the commission being refunded | CO- followed by six digits, for example CO-509314, exactly as it stands on the commission record |
| `source_entry_id` | The earlier commission entry whose money is being returned | An identifier, as read from the commission's own entry lookup |
| `refund_amount` | The amount returned to the customer | In USD, to 2 decimal places, rounded half up, positive, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol |

## What comes back

A single line of text confirming the refund was booked. It names the new commission entry's reference number, the commission reference it was booked to, the earlier entry it answers and the amount returned in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that line is what indicates the money has been put back to the customer.
